HomeHero.welcomeDescription: Fiidiyowyo iimaanka ku salaysan oo ka yimid maktabaddayada, si ay kuu dhiirrigeliyaan, kuu tijaabiyaan, kuuna kiciyaan ka fikir.
HomeHero.morningTitle: Subax wanaagsan! Daqiiqadaha Baybalka ee maanta ayaa ku sugaya.
HomeHero.morningDescription: Maalintaada ku bilow daqiiqado Baybal oo dhiirrigelin leh, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay inay ruuxaaga dhiirrigeliyaan oo kor u qaadaan.
HomeHero.afternoonTitle: Galab wanaagsan! Daqiiqado Baybal oo maalintaada ah.
HomeHero.afternoonDescription: Waxyaabo Baybal oo dhiirrigelin leh, kuna habboon nasashadaada galabta ama dhiirrigelin joogto ah.
HomeHero.eveningTitle: Fiid wanaagsan! Ku naso daqiiqado Baybal.
HomeHero.eveningDescription: Daqiiqado Baybal oo nabadeed si ay kaaga caawiyaan ka fikirka iyo raaxo helidda marka maalintaadu dhammaanayso.
HomeHero.joinUsDescription: Beergooyska waa la gaaray. Nagu soo biir si aan injiilka ula wadaagno adduunka annagoo adeegsanayna warbaahinta dijitaalka ah.
HomeHero.togetherTitle: Wadajir aan u Sheegno Sheekada Ciise

Mission.headline: Fariintu isma beddesho. Habka ay dadku wax u daawadaan ayaa is beddela.
Mission.intro: Waxaan maktabaddeenna fiidiyowga iyo qalabkeenna dib uga dhisaynaa aasaaska, annagoo tobannaan sano oo shaqo tarjumaad ah geynayna barxadaha ay dadku horeba isugu yimaadaan, wax ku daawadaan, wax kuna wadaagaan.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Maktabadda filimada ee ugu tarjumaadda badan adduunka
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Tobannaan sano oo shaqo tarjumaad ah, oo ay qaadeen lammaanayaal adeeg oo la aamini karo, ayaa dhisay maktabad leh kumanaan cod-luqadeed, si dadku ula kulmaan sheekada Ciise luqadda sida ugu qoto dheer qalbigooda u gaarta.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Codad la aamini karo oo loo gudbinayo qaabab cusub
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Waxaan dib u dhisaynaa sida sheekooyinka injiilka muuqaal ahaan loo sheego, annagoo isku darayna tarjumaado la aamini karo iyo qaabab casri ah, si fariintu xor ugu dhex socoto barxadaha, dhaqamada iyo shaashadaha.
Mission.teamPointTitle: Wax ka badan maktabad. Waa koox hawlgal u heellan.
Mission.teamPointDescription: Jesus Film Project waa koox caalami ah oo ka kooban turjubaano, khubaro warbaahin, tifaftirayaal iyo abuurayaal, kuwaas oo tobannaan sano oo khibrad adeeg ah u beddelaya qalab loogu talagalay xer-sameeyayaasha meel kasta.
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Daawadayaasha ku xir fursado la taaban karo oo safarkooda ruuxiga ah ku jira, adigoo ka caawinaya inay qaadaan tallaabada xigta ee bulshada, Qorniinka, ama hawlgalka.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Maktabad warbaahin Masiixi ah oo ballaaran, oo leh kumanaan fiidiyow, filim iyo khayraad ku jira luqado badan, loogu talagalay adeegga iyo wacdinta adduunka oo dhan.
Mission.ministryToolsTitle: Qalab Dijitaal ah oo loogu talagalay Adeegyada
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Maaraynta fiidiyowga, qaybinta waxyaabaha, ka-qaybgalka daawadayaasha iyo falanqayn, loogu talagalay inay adeegyada ka caawiyaan inay si wax ku ool ah u gaaraan dad badan.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Ka caawi dhisidda {accent} ee qalabka hawlgalka
Mission.inviteBody: Waxaan xirfadlayaal, abuurayaal iyo lammaanayaal ugu casuumaynaa helitaan hore. Marka hore tijaabi qalab cusub, bixi jawaab-celin, oo ka caawi qaabaynta alaab loogu talagalay hawlgal dhab ah.
Mission.missionCardAriaHint: Wuxuu furaa bogga hawlgalka Jesus Film

Mission.betaCardAriaHint: Wuxuu biraawsarkaaga ku furaa is-diiwaangelinta beta
